nutshell.headline: An ordinary gift cannot inherit the selected cessation-course price
nutshell.body: The full$100k gift includes a broad18-county lung-health portfolio. Central40% funds quantified branches;60% remains priced with unquantified health.
nutshell.whyItMayWork: Additional cessation and child-asthma access can improve health if it exceeds existing public and clinical services.
nutshell.whyWeAreCautious: Marginal allocation, actual distinct recipients, sustained effects, state hazards and local residence are priors.
nutshell.recommendationBlocker: No verified next-tranche offer or complete all-payer resource budget.

model.headline: Finite disjoint cohorts with full gift retained
model.body: Cessation .72extra initial quitters ×finite state gain; asthma4.375children ×one-year symptom-utility gain. Later quitting/relapse/death remain in both cessation arms.

equation.label: Regional whole-gift QALYs
equation.expression: cessation added people ×(extra quits ×finite state Q −shared harm) ×regional share +asthma added people ×(child share ×finite symptom Q −shared harm) ×regional share −independent harm

model.uncertaintyBoundary: Joint cases are not posterior intervals. Calendar-based mortality recovery is approximate; unquantified portfolio benefits and outside resource inputs remain missing. No threshold retuning.
model.fundingBoundary: Unknown verified funding room. Kick It California, Medi-Cal APS/remediation, existing provider budgets and other donors remain baseline.

evidence.population: Lung Health Study middle-aged adults with airway obstruction
evidence.result: Supports quitting-health mechanism over14.5years; intervention more intensive than Ash Kickers.
evidence.transfer: Do not read arm mortality as conditional state hazard or local course efficacy; all state coefficients are priors.

evidence.design: Healthy Homes II randomized active-comparator trial
evidence.transfer: Apply only child share, one-year window, separate utility and local transfer; adult benefits excluded.

evidence.result: No overall between-group primary asthma-control advantage.
evidence.transfer: Different intervention, but supports explicit null sensitivity.

evidence.design: Official giving/domain plus historical municipal agreement
evidence.result: Legal identity distinguished from similarly named affiliates.
evidence.transfer: 18-county scope does not verify current SF marginal cohort or funding room.

reservations: Marginal allocations and unit costs are unverified.
Mortality recovery is a cohort-calendar proxy, not exact individual smoking history.
Public and alternative access can erase marginal health.
SF/Bay future health shares are priors.
Gross associated resource envelope is partial; unquantified branches' outside inputs are unmeasured.
Secondary financial extract is context only; current primary filing unavailable.
excludedBenefits: Adult asthma health extrapolated from child trial
Cessation lifetime tail or independent disease/death credits
Asthma mortality or health beyond one year
